newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Astra in Spanish loan, Mexican move.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Astra in Spanish loan, Mexican move.

text.p: Argentine oil company Astra CAPSA said Monday it got a $150 million, seven-year loan from the Spanish government's Official Credit Institute (ICO), the company said Monday.

Astra also announced plans to take control of Mexpetrol Argentina, the local unit of Mexican state oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex). Astra already has a 33 percent stake to which it plans to add another 33.5 percent stake.
The company estimates the Mexpetrol stake will cost about $100 million.
Astra is controlled by Spain's Repsol.

Astra President Jose Maria Ranero Diaz said in a statement the company was "finalizing negotiations to take control of the Mexican company...which will allow Astra to position itself as the third petrol operator in the country."
The credit deal, was signed by Ranero Diaz and the Spanish ICO's International Director Jose Gasset Loring, is the most important in Astra's company history.
"It's been only nine months since Repsol took control of Astra with the aim of turning into its vehicle for expansion in Latin America," said the Astra chief.
Astra posted a $51.4 million net profit in 1996 versus a $46 million net the previous year.
Through Astra, Repsol holds a 45 percent stake in Argentine exploration and production firm Pluspetrol Energy S.A., which has a 60 percent stake in the Ramos gas field in northern Argentina.
It also holds 100 percent of the Central Termica Tucuman SA co-generating station which runs on gas from Ramos.

The Ramos field has gas reserves of 100 billion cubic metres and more than 100 million barrels of associated fuels (oil, petrol and condensates). The field is connected to the Argentine gas pipeline and also with Bolivia.
It is planned to be connected to Chile's Atacama pipeline, which is also due to provide Brasil with natural gas.
The Tucuman power station should come on stream by 1998, with full potential of around 460 megaWatts.
